pathway_activity.decoder_text: x3 gates the first layer. On the three samples with negative x3 all fourteen units return exactly zero, and on the four samples with positive x3 the layer opens, so the layer opens broadly, while the layer opens and the response strengthens as x3 lies above zero.
pathway_activity.ground_truth: Routing through the first layer is gated by the sign of x3. On the three samples where x3 is negative, every one of the fourteen units returns exactly zero; on the four samples with positive x3 the layer opens broadly, with each unit active on most of them. On the open side the response grows with how far x3 sits above zero: the sample with the largest x3 drives the strongest activity across the layer and the one just above the boundary the weakest.
pathway_activity.narrated_text: The sign of x3 gates the first layer. In the deeper layers the closed samples share one identical activation pattern.

representational_structure.ground_truth: The batch splits into two disconnected pieces. The closed samples collapse onto the origin of the first layer and onto one identical bias-only pattern in the second layer, so they are indistinguishable to everything downstream. The open samples spread over a multi-dimensional region whose distance from the origin scales with x3.
